0022600210.text: The Golden State Warriors (7-3, riding a seven-game winning streak and 5-1 at home) host the New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, on a two-game losing streak) in the Warriors' 11th game of the season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and New Orleans 5th in the Southwest, 4 games back. Golden State will be without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and is a game-time decision; New Orleans will be without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and their most recent meeting was a 113-109 loss to the Pelicans in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
